I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.
Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.
“Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time?’ But I came to this time for this cause.

“My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.

translations.web: What will I say? He has both spoken to me, and himself has done it. I will walk carefully all my years because of the anguish of my soul.
translations.bsb: What can I say? He has spoken to me, and He Himself has done this. I will walk slowly all my years because of the anguish of my soul.
translations.kjv: What shall I say? he hath both spoken unto me, and himself hath done it: I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul.
translations.asv: What shall I say? he hath both spoken unto me, and himself hath done it: I shall go softly all my years because of the bitterness of my soul.
